evidence_snippets: Supported data types The following are the supported data types for this connector: BIGINT BINARY BIT CHAR DATE DATETIME DATETIME2 DATETIMEOFFSET DECIMAL FLOAT DECIMAL FLOAT INT MONEY NCHAR NVARCHAR REAL LSEG SMALLDATETIME SMALLINT SMALLMONEY TINYINT UNIQUEIDENTIFIER VARBINARY VARCHAR Actions The Azure Synapse connector lets you execute your stored procedures and custom SQL queries in the format supported by your Azure Synapse.

Re-authorization for authorization code If you are using Authorization code authentication type and have made any cofiguration changes in your Azure Synapse application, you must re-authorize your Azure Synapse connection.
The following authentication types are supported by the Azure Synapse connection: User Password Azure AD To understand how to configure these authentication types, see Configure authentication .
